name: Pension Alpenwelt
beschreibung: The Gasthof Pension Alpenwelt is located in the municipality of Tannheim in the Tannheimer Tal. The surroundings offer numerous opportunities for hikers and winter sports enthusiasts all year round. The rooms are functionally furnished and equipped with a bathroom and TV. The amenities include a lounge and parking spaces. The atmosphere of the house is simple and informal. The target group consists of active holidaymakers and families. The inn's restaurant serves regional and seasonal dishes.
